answer.markdown:
Node.js 22 is the current latest LTS version, entering LTS in October 2024. Node.js 20 remains in active LTS since October 2023, but Node.js 22 supersedes it as the newest long-term support release.

**Where the models disagree**  
Two models identify Node.js 22 (October 2024) as the latest LTS, while one model cites Node.js 20 (October 2023). The majority position is better supported because Node.js follows a predictable release schedule where even-numbered versions become LTS annually; Node.js 22 is the most recent even-numbered release and its LTS promotion in October 2024 aligns with that cadence.
